# Levi Henry Group

> Levi Henry Group is a consulting, education, and technology company founded by Levi Henry. It helps individuals in Nigeria build high-income remote careers in tech sales, and helps businesses build the sales and revenue systems that drive growth. Its flagship program, Remote SDR Training, teaches people to get hired as remote Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) by companies in the US, UK, and Canada, and earn in dollars from home, even with no prior sales experience.

Levi Henry spent 12 years as a music professional in Nigeria (mixing engineer, producer, and songwriter, working with more than 1,000 artists) before moving into remote sales for North American companies. With no prior B2B sales experience, he became a top-performing SDR, then Account Executive, then Sales Team Lead at a US CRM and AI company, all while working remotely from Nigeria. He now teaches others the exact path he took.

## Programs and offers

- [Remote SDR Training](https://thelevihenry.com/remote-sdr-training): The flagship course. A step-by-step program showing Nigerians how to get hired as a remote SDR by a US, UK, or Canadian company, reach hiring managers directly, call them, and win the interview, even with no sales experience. Covers prospecting, cold calling, and discovery, the three core SDR skills.
- [For individuals](https://thelevihenry.com/individuals): Coaching and education for individuals building high-income sales and remote-work skills.
- [For businesses](https://thelevihenry.com/businesses): Consulting for businesses building or scaling sales development, marketing, and revenue operations.
- [LHG Academy](https://thelevihenry.com/academy): The online learning platform where students take the course, submit assignments for review, and get coaching.
